sermon.title: Remember Not 07/14/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer preaches Isaiah 43: remember not the former things, for God is doing a new thing and making rivers in the desert. God blots out our sins. Rahab, Naaman, the high priest’s servant and the women Jesus healed all left the old behind when they drank of His river.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.answer: He says more than in a dead man.

faqs.answer: Yes, a Baptist church back east.

faqs.answer: It reminds of Christ’s death, which saves.
